pairing_policy: Within each repetition, process-noise conditions share standard-normal training and validation observation-error arrays. Particle-number conditions use the corresponding prefixes of arrays generated at N=500. Pair-count conditions share the same observed trajectories and nested pair samples. Training, validation, and latent test trajectories remain separate.
selection_policy: Weak LASSO uses only the independent validation weak residual. Truth, latent test metrics, and reported errors are excluded from fitting and selection. Weak OLS is the raw minimum-norm solution on the identical training system.
failure_policy: Retain every prespecified repetition, nonconverged path candidate, boundary selection, rank deficiency, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric. Do not rerun to improve a result.
baseline_parity_policy: At N=500, process sigma=0.05, and P=10000, weak LASSO and weak OLS must reproduce the independently verified fixed sigma_obs=0.01 nominal records.
manuscript_policy: Use this fixed sigma_obs=0.01 run for the representative 10D fit, coupled rollout, and process-noise, particle-number, and pair-count appendix results so that Appendix E.4 and the main-text comparison table share one nominal observation-noise condition.
